Estimate the standard enthalpy of formation of dichlorodifluoromethane, CCl2F2(g) (Fig. 12.18). This compound is also known as Freon-12 and has been used as a refriger- ant because of its low reactivity and high volatility. It and other related chlorofluorocar- bons (CFCs) are being phased out because of their role in depleting the ozone layer in the outer atmosphere, as discussed in Section 20.6.
